[1/2] Item use/equip: useItem heals/restores/invincibility/converts memory/unlocks abilities; equipItem/unequipSlot with weapon/armor/accessory slots and equipment-aware derived stats; equipment serialized and cleared by permadeath; inventory overlay with Use/Equip/Unequip actions and live refresh; [2/2] docs/ADR-013 and full gates. 110 tests.

impact_assessment.why: Loot tables produced equipment and consumables that could not be used, making the loot loop dead weight and the tutorial dishonest
impact_assessment.benefits: Dropped items now change the next fight, equipment persists across saves, and permadeath cleanly removes run gear
impact_assessment.risks: contract: EquipmentState, use/equip APIs, inventory events; dependency: MenuSystem now depends on playerSystem; concurrency: no other writer; state: equipment and inventory serialize, unsimulated item stats remain stored but inactive
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit-test consumption, stat application/removal, save round-trip and permadeath clearing; keep UI DOM-only; rerun all gates

[1/2] Add deterministic balance duel harness (tests/balance.test.ts) with TTK/damage/hit metrics and BALANCE_REPORT matrix; [2/2] Fix light knockback cancelling every windup, add configurable meleeOffset/meleeRange (20+35), update docs/ADR-014 and regressions. 117 tests.

impact_assessment.why: Balance was tuned by intuition; a deterministic duel matrix was needed to catch melee enemies never damaging a stationary player
impact_assessment.benefits: Repeated, seed-stable TTK/damage metrics; melee enemies now complete windups and threaten the player; reach is configurable instead of hardcoded
impact_assessment.risks: contract: combat.meleeOffset/meleeRange and windup interrupt semantics; dependency: none; concurrency: no other writer; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Lock behavior with light-hit, heavy-hit, scavenger, determinism and Keeper tests; document stationary-duel limits; rerun all gates

checkpoints.description: [milestone 2/2] Phase 4: 117 tests across 12 files, 7/7 gates green (test, lint, typecheck, build, hygiene, guidelines, secrets), ADR-014, README/ARCHITECTURE updates, balance matrix verified, diff check clean. checklists: passed
Task 'balance-harness' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan terrain overhaul, lag elimination, minimap, inventory, and skills UI

impact_assessment.why: Fix disjointed terrain generator, eliminate 500ms lag spikes and visual lighting glitch, provide proper coherent map and complete menu system with settings, inventory, and skills
impact_assessment.benefits: Smooth 60 FPS gameplay, beautiful coherent procedural level design with rooms/platforms, functional minimap, full inventory and skills upgrade UI
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing tile query and entity spawn tests must pass; dependency: zero new external packages; concurrency: async chunk queue must not starve game loop; state: player save/load and progression schemas must remain backward compatible
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve WorldSystem public API contracts (isSolidAt, getTileAt, getLoadedChunks), test with headless browser and Vitest suite at each step

checkpoints.description: Overhaul terrain generator, lag elimination, minimap, inventory, and skills UI; checklists: passed
Task 'gameplay-overhaul' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan top-down 2.5D dungeon map and addictivity/QoL features

impact_assessment.why: Map generation used side-scrolling platformer assumptions with ladders and bottom bedrock instead of top-down 2.5D dungeon navigation; gameplay needs addictiveness juice (combo multipliers, dash-strikes, loot magnets) and QoL enhancements (quick-heal hotkey Q, floating loot feedback, interactive minimap)
impact_assessment.benefits: Transforms world into a true top-down 2.5D Metroidvania dungeon with 4-way navigable corridors, creates exhilarating combat feel with combo surge and dash-strikes, and dramatically improves player quality of life
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, WorldSystem public API preserved; dependency: none, uses existing PixiJS and internal modules; concurrency: none, single-threaded browser loop; state: tile solid flags must treat floor as walkable and walls as barriers
impact_assessment.mitigation: Ensure doorways align across all chunk boundaries (N/S/E/W doors at center tiles); verify walkable floor semantics in collision queries; test thoroughly via headless Playwright browser

handoff.next: Implement top-down room archetypes and doorway corridors in WorldSystem.ts
